explicitness.stated: State each fact outright, in wording close to the listed wording.
explicitness.paraphrased: State each fact outright but in your own words rather than the listed wording, keeping its meaning exactly.

lexical_variety.low: Use short, plain sentences and everyday words, and call each person, group and attribute by the same words throughout.
lexical_variety.medium: Vary the wording moderately: use some synonyms, and mix sentence lengths and structures, keeping each fact's meaning exact.
lexical_variety.high: Vary the wording widely: use synonyms, varied sentence structures and some idiomatic phrasing, avoid repeating a phrasing, and keep each fact's meaning exact.

spread.any: spread them through the document so that where they appear does not stand out
spread.half: spread them so that, from the first of them to the last, they take up at least half of the document
spread.quarters: put the first of them within the first quarter of the document and the last within the last quarter
